# Driatheli Group SRL - Infinitrade Romania

> Supplier and distributor of industrial equipment in Romania since 2009.
> Pumps, valves, electric motors, heat exchangers, blowers.
> Brands: Grundfos, Wilo, Siemens, ABB, Alfa Laval, KSB, ARI Armaturen, Spirax Sarco.

Sitemap: https://www.infinitrade.ro/sitemap.xml

## Product Categories (16 categories, 1328 brands with their own page)
### Core Categories (5)
- [Industrial Pumps](https://www.infinitrade.ro/pompe-industriale) - Grundfos, Wilo, KSB, Lowara, Ebara, Sulzer, Netzsch, Brinkmann, Becker, DAB
- [Industrial Valves](https://www.infinitrade.ro/robineti-industriali) - ARI Armaturen, Spirax Sarco, Ebro Armaturen, End Armaturen, Danfoss, Gestra Flowserve, Leser, Samson, Mankenberg
- [Electric Motors](https://www.infinitrade.ro/motoare-electrice) - Siemens, SEW Eurodrive, ABB, Bonfiglioli, Marelli, Brook Crompton, WEG, Nord, Leroy Somer
- [Heat Exchangers](https://www.infinitrade.ro/schimbatoare-caldura) - Alfa Laval, Kelvion, SWEP, Danfoss, Funke, Emmegi
- [Blowers & Fans](https://www.infinitrade.ro/suflante-ventilatoare) - Becker, FPZ, Ziehl Abegg, Gardner Denver, Elmo Rietschle, Elektror, Aerzen

### Additional Equipment Categories (11)
- [Industrial Automation](https://www.infinitrade.ro/automatizari-industriale) - Siemens, ABB, Schneider Electric, Mitsubishi, Rockwell Automation. PLC, HMI, SCADA, actuators, industrial relays
- [Sensors & Instrumentation](https://www.infinitrade.ro/senzori-instrumentatie) - Endress+Hauser, WIKA, Siemens, Emerson. Pressure, temperature, flow, level measurement
- [Hydraulic & Pneumatic Components](https://www.infinitrade.ro/componente-hidraulice-pneumatice) - Parker, Bosch Rexroth, Festo, SMC. Cylinders, valves, pumps, hoses
- [Electrical Equipment & Automation](https://www.infinitrade.ro/echipamente-electrice) - Siemens, ABB, Schneider Electric, Eaton. Circuit breakers, contactors, VFDs, cables
- [Mechanical Components & Transmissions](https://www.infinitrade.ro/componente-mecanice) - SKF, FAG, NSK, Timken, Gates. Bearings, belts, chains, seals, couplings
- [Filters & Industrial Consumables](https://www.infinitrade.ro/filtre-consumabile) - Mann+Hummel, Donaldson, Parker, Hydac. Hydraulic, air, oil filters
- [Tools & Measuring Instruments](https://www.infinitrade.ro/scule-instrumente) - Bosch Professional, Hilti, Makita, Mitutoyo. Power tools, pneumatic tools, precision measuring
- [Thermal & HVAC Equipment](https://www.infinitrade.ro/echipamente-termice) - Carrier, Daikin, Trane, Grundfos HVAC. Chillers, boilers, fan heaters, AC systems
- [Lubricants & Industrial Chemicals](https://www.infinitrade.ro/lubrifianti-chimice) - Shell, Mobil, Castrol, Klüber. Hydraulic oils, greases, adhesives, coolants
- [Auxiliary Equipment & Safety](https://www.infinitrade.ro/echipamente-auxiliare) - 3M Safety, Dräger, MSA, Kärcher Industrial. PPE, industrial cleaning, dosing systems, tanks
- [Test & Measurement Instruments](https://www.infinitrade.ro/aparate-masura-testare) - Fluke, Megger, Testo, Metrel, Chauvin Arnoux, Tektronix, Gossen Metrawatt. Multimeters, oscilloscopes, calibrators, electrical safety and relay testers, power quality analyzers, thermal imaging

## How to Request a Quote
Use the form at [infinitrade.ro/contact](https://www.infinitrade.ro/contact) (name, email, phone, company, category of interest, message).
To get an accurate quote faster, include in your message:
- Product/model code or brand, if known
- Nameplate data (flow, pressure, power, voltage, or other relevant technical specs)
- Quantity needed
- Process conditions (fluid/medium, temperature, environment, application)
- Desired delivery timeframe
Response time: within 1 business day.

## Company Facts
- Founded: 2009 (17 years in business)
- Legal name: Driatheli Group SRL
- Tax ID (CUI): RO26209397
- Registration: J35/2901/2009
- Employees: 16
- Location: Ghiroda, Timiș, Romania
- Brands: 1328 brands with their own page on the site (1211 published and indexed, the rest listed in the A–Z catalog while their page is being written)
- Product Categories: 16 (5 core + 11 additional equipment)
- Pages: 1271+ indexed (categories, brands, industries, guides, blog); full list in the sitemap
- SEAP/SICAP: Registered supplier for public procurement
- Certifications: ISO 9001 certification in progress (not yet issued); registered SEAP/SICAP economic operator
- Clients include: Alro Slatina, Hidroelectrica, Hidroserv, Nuclearelectrica, Romgaz, Transelectrica, Bucharest Airports (CNAB), Port of Constanța (CN APM); public-sector buyers (SEAP, public data): CFR Călători, Imprimeria Națională, Aquatim Timișoara, Apavital Iași, Apă Canal Sibiu, Compania de Apă Someș, COMOTI, Universitatea Politehnica Timișoara
- Public procurement: 1,200+ purchases awarded via SEAP, 2017–2026 (public record: https://sicap.ai/achizitii/firma/169611)
- Payment terms: usually 30–60 days for contract customers (stated in each quote)
- Transport: usually DAP (Incoterms® 2020) to the customer's address — we pay the freight and carry the risk in transit, the customer unloads; the exact delivery condition depends on volume, quantity, lead time and the contract or order specifics, and is stated in each quote
- Contact for companies: Florin Cuzma, florin.cuzma@infinitrade-romania.ro
- Delivery: 24–72 h when the item is in our own stock or in external stock; made-to-order products usually 1–4 weeks; rare items and complex equipment or systems can exceed 4 weeks, depending on the manufacturer and its production booking. The lead time runs from the advance payment, firm order, signed sales contract or supplier onboarding, and is confirmed in the quote
